# Non-BYZ deduplicated monthly fallback pulse for Slot 75 (oe_pglh_).
# When BYZ scheduler slot 75 has already run this calendar month, global_var:oe_pglh_ran_m == oe_ml_month_now
# and this trigger evaluates false in O(1), preventing double execution.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_pglh_fallback_pulse } }

oe_pglh_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1337
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_pglh_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			tag = GLH
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH } tag = TIM }
			AND = { is_ai = no oe_pglh_is_host = yes }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_pglh_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}
